“The AI models are getting smarter and smarter... But inside the enterprise, we’re not seeing the same level of progress.” — Databricks Co-founder and CEO Ali Ghodsi

The missing piece is business context.

Enterprise knowledge is siloed across systems, and not everyone should have access to all of it. Searching everything on demand is slow, costly, and incomplete.

At DATA + AI LIVE, Ali explains how Genie Ontology automatically builds a permission-aware metadata graph across enterprise data and connected systems, so AI agents know where to look and deliver better answers, faster, for fewer tokens.

Enterprise knowledge is siloed across systems, and not everyone should have access to all of it. Searching everything on demand is slow, costly, and incomplete.

At DATA + AI LIVE, Ali explains how Genie Ontology automatically builds a permission-aware metadata graph across enterprise data and connected systems, so AI agents know where to look and deliver better answers, faster, for fewer tokens.
